usedFor: inflow-inventory holds customers and purchase orders, and SproutVideo receives a viewer through “Create a New Login”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in inflow-inventory, then “Create a New Login” in SproutVideo
bestTemplate.why: A new customer in inflow-inventory gets a viewer login in SproutVideo without anyone creating it by hand.

watchOut: “Create a New Login” adds a real viewer login, so confirm the customer should see your videos first.
